name: astro
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project astro --web

options.command: rm -rf .lib && tsc --project ./libs/astro/tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && BABEL_ENV=cjs babel --config-file ./libs/astro/babel.config.js libs/astro/src --out-dir .lib/cjs --extensions ".ts,.tsx,.js"  --copy-files && BABEL_ENV=esm babel --config-file ./libs/astro/babel.config.js libs/astro/src --out-dir .lib/ --extensions ".ts,.tsx,.js" --copy-files && cp libs/astro/README.md .lib && cp libs/astro/MIGRATION.md .lib
